text:
maya: urgent: prod-eu embeddings showing intermittent 502s on short prompts. Root cause: tokenizer fallback at token boundary. I built tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix that passed unit + staging integration. Request expedited ops clearance for staged canary (5% -> 25% -> 100%) in ~20m. @kevin @sasha @ops-duty please review.

kevin: checked staging traces, matches a rare split. +1 for rollout if auto-rollback is enabled and Dedicated customers get image pin.

sasha: need explicit abort criteria before I approve.

maya: rollback criteria: auto-rollback if 5xx rate increases >2% absolute vs baseline for 5m OR p50 latency up >150ms sustained 5m. Manual rollback: `/deploybot rollback service=embedder version=previous`. Previous image kept on standby. Release notes draft posted.

ops-duty: oncall ack. Will approve once Dedicated image sha is pinned and CS gets a blurb. Request 30m change window from canary start.

riya: Dedicated pin sha: `sha256:abcd1234ef56deadbeef7890`. Note: existing sessions unaffected, only new tokenizations use hotfix.

deploybot: deploybot: initiating staged rollout: service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix steps=5,25,100 auto-rollback=on-error. Starting canary now.

kevin: set alert to page if error spike >1.5% absolute. Watching.

sasha: sec reviewed diff, no new privileges or network changes. :thumbsup: 

ops-duty: expedited approval granted. Change window +30m from canary start. CS notified. Maya paste release note.

maya: Release note: "Fix: tokenizer boundary case causing intermittent 502s for short prompts in prod-eu. Rollout: staged canary with auto-rollback on error spike. Hotfix image: tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. Dedicated: pinned to sha256:abcd1234ef56deadbeef7890."

deploybot: deploybot: canary 5% applied to prod-eu. Monitoring baseline for 5m.

maya: canary green at 10m; error rate flat, latency stable. Proceeding to 25%.

deploybot: deploybot: canary 25% applied. Telemetry window 10m.

kevin: metrics look clean at 25%. No anomalies. +1 to 100%.

maya: proceeding to 100% now, ETA ~15m to finish ramp.

deploybot: deploybot: ramping to 100%...

deploybot: deploybot: rollout 100% complete for service=embedder image=tokenizer-v2.3.1-hotfix. No auto-rollback triggered.

sasha: good work — please do a 2h post-deploy verification and confirm no late regressions.

ops-duty: closing expedite window. Changelog updated and Dedicated pinned. Tagging ops-runbook for post-check.

maya: thanks all, will post 2h verification summary here."
